reason: One major logic bug (retailer restocking) still distorts core dynamics, and stdout purity issues can break evaluation. With one iteration remaining, we should implement targeted, low-risk fixes that materially improve realism and reliability: correct restocking, ensure JSON-only output, align stockout metrics with final state, route policy/venue updates via buffers, and gate expensive counterfactuals. These changes will substantially raise code quality and stability while keeping model behavior backward-compatible.

specific_areas: Fix retailer restock logic: zero floor, clamp when stock >= target, minimum 1 only when recovering from zero
Ensure final stdout is JSON-only: add quiet mode, route logs/warnings to stderr, skip visualization when quiet
Move policy and venue updates to buffers and apply in commit for consistency
Recompute stockout observable post-commit using final stock; remove precommit mismatch
Add compute_policy_effect flag (default false) and optional downscaling for counterfactual evaluation
Add unit tests: restocking behavior, stockout metric coherence, and stdout purity
Optional (behind parameter): venue_exposure_weight to modulate disease risk via venue exposure, default 0 to preserve current behavior

task_understanding.adjustments: Prioritize blocking logic defects and output contract compliance (pure JSON) over feature additions in the final iteration. Treat buffer-commit consistency as a correctness concern, not just style.

data_analysis.adjustments: Replace placeholder evaluation with basic sanity checks (e.g., non-increasing stock after over-target, non-negative prices, stable adoption bounds). If external ground truth is unavailable, report internal consistency metrics and skip policy counterfactual by default.

model_planning.adjustments: Focus on minimal-risk, high-impact fixes. Gate any new modeling (e.g., venue-based exposure) behind parameters defaulting to off. Defer broader calibration or misinformation enhancements beyond this iteration.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement precise diffs: restock fix, buffer-commit for policy/venue updates, post-commit stockout recompute, compute_policy_effect flag, quiet mode. Add clear comments and maintain backward compatibility of parameter names/aliases.

code_verification.adjustments: Add targeted unit tests: (1) restock does not increase when stock >= target; (2) restock recovers from zero with at least 1; (3) stockout observable equals 1 only when final stock == 0; (4) no extraneous stdout before final JSON. Run lint/static checks for stray print calls.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Enable deterministic, quick run configuration for CI: set QUIET=1, compute_policy_effect=false, reduced T/N for smoke tests. Ensure seeds are fixed and visualization disabled in quiet mode.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Default to compute_policy_effect=false; if enabled, downscale population/duration. Validate metric coherence (e.g., stockout vs inventory, adoption in [0,1]) before emitting final JSON.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Produce a concise change log highlighting: restock fix, output purity, buffer-commit consistency, stockout metric correction, and evaluation gating. Document new parameters (quiet, compute_policy_effect, venue_exposure_weight) and defaults.
